payment-failed.about: billing for your Contentrain Studio workspace

payment-failed.lead: We couldn't charge your payment method for the **{planName}** subscription on **{workspaceName}**.

payment-failed.notes:
You have until **{gracePeriodEndsText}** to update your payment details. If the charge doesn't go through by then, the workspace will be paused until the payment goes through. Your content is safe, and access comes back as soon as the charge succeeds.

If you think this is a mistake, check with your card issuer or reply to this email.

payment-failed.subject: Action required: payment failed for {workspaceName}

subscription-cancel-scheduled.about: billing for your Contentrain Studio workspace

subscription-cancel-scheduled.lead: Your **{planName}** subscription for **{workspaceName}** is set to cancel. Everything stays available until **{accessEndsText}**, so you keep what you paid for.
subscription-cancel-scheduled.name: Subscription cancel scheduled
subscription-cancel-scheduled.notes:
After that date the workspace moves to the free plan. Changed your mind? You can keep the subscription anytime before then.

If this was unexpected, reply to this email and we'll sort it out.
subscription-cancel-scheduled.preheader: You can keep the subscription anytime before then.
subscription-cancel-scheduled.subject: Your {planName} plan stays active until {accessEndsText}

subscription-canceled.name: Subscription — Canceled
subscription-canceled.notes:
